faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. You can create and download as many barcodes as you like, with no sign-up and no watermark.
faq.q2: Which barcode type should I choose?
faq.a2: Use QR Code for links, Wi-Fi, and contacts. Use EAN-13 or UPC-A for retail products, Code 128 for shipping and inventory, and Data Matrix for small labels.
faq.q3: Can I use the barcodes commercially?
faq.a3: Yes. The images you create are yours to use on products, packaging, and print. For EAN and UPC on retail products, register your numbers with GS1.
faq.q4: Why does my barcode show an error?
faq.a4: Each type has its own rules. For example, EAN-13 accepts only 12 or 13 digits. Read the error message and adjust your data.
